textVoice.title: Text voice
textVoice.description: Type to speak in Brazilian Portuguese. This mode replaces your microphone with a synthesized voice.
textVoice.micOff: Your real microphone stays off in this mode, including when joining future calls.
textVoice.placeholder: Type what you want to say…
textVoice.enterHint: Enter to speak · Shift+Enter for a new line
textVoice.unavailable: Speech is unavailable. Ask the administrator to start the synthesis service on this instance.
textVoice.muted: Join a call and unmute to speak. Server restrictions also apply.
textVoice.ready: Ready to speak in Brazilian Portuguese.
textVoice.privacy: Text is processed by the Backspace instance and is not posted to chat. Call participants hear it as your normal voice.

soundboard.uploadHint: Up to 5.2 seconds, 5 MB source file. Maximum 40 sounds per server.
soundboard.name: Sound name
soundboard.permissionHint: A role with Create soundboard sounds permission is required to add effects.
soundboard.invalidAudio: Choose a valid audio file up to 5.2 seconds and 5 MB.

screenPicker.chooseHintSystem: Your system will ask which screen or window to share.
screenPicker.audioNeedsRepick: The system audio setting applies once you choose again.
screenPicker.unsupported: This browser can't share your screen.
screenPicker.captureFailed: The capture could not be started.
screenPicker.startFailed: The stream could not be started.

streamSettings.previewHint: Controls the thumbnail shown before watching. Does not change the stream video.
streamSettings.title: Stream Settings
streamSettings.chromeEchoNote: Chrome can exclude Backspace audio when the capture type supports it
streamSettings.electronWindowsAudioNote: Windows loopback may capture call audio when restrictOwnAudio is unsupported
streamSettings.electronMacAudioNote: macOS 13+ requires Screen & System Audio Recording permission
streamSettings.electronLinuxAudioNote: Linux requires PulseAudio compatibility; Backspace audio may also be captured

systemAudioNote.excluded: Viewers hear your computer's sound, but not the voice chat or other Backspace audio.
systemAudioNote.excludedMac: Viewers hear your Mac's sound, but not the voice chat or other Backspace audio. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedWindows: This Windows version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On Windows 11, Backspace's own audio is left out.
systemAudioNote.includedMac: This macOS version shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. On macOS 14.2 and later, Backspace's own audio is left out. macOS asks for Screen & System Audio Recording permission.
systemAudioNote.includedLinux: Linux shares all sound, the voice chat included: viewers will hear their own voices. Needs PulseAudio, or PipeWire with pipewire-pulse.
systemAudioNote.unavailableMac: System audio needs macOS 13 or later.

streamSettings.systemAudioStartFailed: Could not start the stream with system audio. Disable Share system audio if this platform does not support it.
streamSettings.systemAudioAddFailed: Could not add system audio to the stream.
streamSettings.systemAudioLiveUnavailable: System audio can only be added when a stream starts. Restart the stream to include it.
streamSettings.softwareH264Fallback: Hardware H264 encoding is unavailable. Software OpenH264 is in use; VP9 may perform better.
